    Decomposition by the first represented arrow #

    A morphism in the free reversed linear path category between distinct vertices is a finite sum of one represented arrow out of its categorical source followed by a coefficient path. This is the free-category form used by Ringel's recursive fullness construction.

              Every free-path endomorphism is a scalar identity plus a sum grouped by its first represented categorical arrow. This is the diagonal counterpart of exists_eq_outgoingSum_of_ne; the scalar is exactly the coefficient of the trivial path.
